news.summary: Open USD is live on Solana, letting businesses mint and burn 1:1 for dollars at no cost, with over $1 billion committed to liquidity.
news.title: Open USD Is Live on Solana

news.summary: This study evaluates SIMD-0675, a geo-aware leader schedule for Solana. It reorders the stake-weighted random schedule so that consecutive leaders are geographically close, which cuts handoff latency. No validator’s number of leader windows changes. Two parameters are tuned: STAK
news.title: Geo-Aware Leader Schedule

news.summary: Beginning the last week of October 2026, Samsung Wallet will support USDC cross-border transfers on Solana across 82 million U.S. Galaxy devices.
news.title: Samsung Partners with Solana to Natively Deliver Stablecoins in Samsung Wallet to 82 Million U.S. Galaxy Devices

news.summary: September saw growth across tokenized stocks, stablecoins, payments, and DeFi. Tokenized equity supply reached $684 million, stablecoins hit $17.51 billion, and the network processed 3.18 billion non-vote transactions.
news.title: Solana Ecosystem Roundup: September 2026

news.summary: Onchain open-source delivery-versus-payment infrastructure, tailored for the world’s leading financial institutions
news.title: Solana Foundation Launches Solana DvP, an Atomic Settlement Program Built for Financial Institutions

news.summary: Arrive at Breakpoint London 2026 ready for a 6,000-person event, with travel booked, devices secured, and your week mapped in advance.
news.title: Breakpoint 2026: Booked Breakpoint? Let's Get You Prepped (Part 2)

news.summary: web3.js v3 is ready for general use, while Solana activates a feature gate to cut slot times from 250ms to 200ms after one epoch.
news.title: Solana Changelog: October 8, 2026

news.summary: Devnet lists Alpenglow as a notable feature gate alongside new Agave, Firedancer, Superbank, Web3.js, Kit, and program SDK releases.
news.title: Solana Changelog: October 1, 2026

news.summary: Twelve more speakers join Breakpoint 2026 at Olympia London, taking the stage from 15–17 November across finance, trading and infrastructure.
news.title: More Breakpoint 2026 Speakers Confirmed for London

news.summary: Microscope decodes Solana program and Squads multisig activity into Grafana dashboards and alerts for Slack, Telegram, and PagerDuty.
news.title: Introducing Solana Microscope: Program Monitoring and Alerts

news.summary: Payment Channels topped 1 million payments per second in testing as Solana stablecoin supply reached $17.3 billion and x402 share hit 76%.
news.title: Payments on Solana: September 2026 in Five Stories

news.summary: Solana can give AI agents permissionless access to compute, training, identity, memory, and machine-native payments.
news.title: Solana x AI: The Democratization Layer
